rationale: Fault inception at t=0.05 s (first voltage below 1.0 pu). All samples remain connected while voltage stays above the staged ride-through minimums (0.2 pu through 0.15 s, 0.5 pu through 0.7 s, 0.85 pu through 2.0 s). Reactive support: while V<0.9 pu, iq meets or exceeds 0.2 pu after the 0.1 s response deadline (e.g. iq=0.25 at 0.12 s); at t=0.55 s V=0.9 pu is at the threshold with iq=0.22 pu. Minimum trace voltage is 0.55 pu.
